subject: sty
title: STY.------LANG.DY.
description: Chart on book p. 221 (WAC-19). STY (style) is the subject, with the (C) prefix, "the concept of"; LANG-DY (language dynamics) is the partner. From the subject: POST (postulation) and AF-NT (affinity nature). From POST: CULT-AF-B (culture affinity basis). From CULT-AF-B: INFO-DOC (information documentation). From AF-NT: ATTN (attraction), T-C-IMP (time continuum implications) and TM (terminology—or terms of a definition). From T-C-IMP: RE-ST (restructuralism). From TM: INDIV-TD (individual tendencies). From INDIV-TD: IF-SPT (infra-spirituality).
